verdict.rationale: An email SaaS could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so this axis applies. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any candidate path, and no docs mention a downloadable spec. The official MCP server is a separate agent-integration capability and is not a downloadable API spec, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
